In the online A/B test, GenRec showed an average treatment effect of **+0.115%** on the short-term homepage engagement metric, compared with the production model. The p-value was **P = 3.1 × 10⁻¹⁰**, and the result is marked as statistically significant (Figure 3, page 1).

The test used about 10% of Netflix traffic for 4 weeks. The Phase-2 GenRec model ran in a low-data, low-signals configuration (page 1).
